name: @penguinharness/evo-harness-rsi-toolkit
description: Evo-Harness: compile negative execution feedback into general and task-type skills, then freeze and evaluate through native Penguin workers.

penguin.title: Evo-Harness RSI Toolkit
penguin.description_zh: 按 Evo-Harness 的负反馈反思与批次编译学习技能，通过 Penguin 原生子 Agent、State 和评测协议完成冻结对比。
penguin.short_description: Compile execution feedback into reusable skills.
penguin.short_description_zh: 从执行反馈按批次编译可复用技能。

quick_start.prompt: Use evo-harness-rsi-toolkit for one complete training batch and frozen held-out comparison. Resolve the Target, train/test Benchmarks, model and current experiment budget before paid calls.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 使用 evo-harness-rsi-toolkit 完成一个训练批次与冻结技能的独立测试对比。付费调用前统一确认 Target、训练/测试 Benchmark、模型和本次预算。
